title: Cover Design: Leaflets & Folders
slide_intent: Teach designers to concentrate a small cover on one idea so it can command attention despite its limited area.
strategic_value: NASA can give related brochures the coherence of a series while allowing each mission to have its own silhouette.
demonstration: Six narrow covers form a three-by-two array. The upper row uses similar title positions and aircraft or spacecraft silhouettes for Space Shuttle, Apollo-Soyuz and Skylab. The lower row explores a photograph, large type and film imagery.
practical_value: When commissioning a leaflet series, settle the repeated title and identification positions before choosing the one image or typographic emphasis for each subject.

content_islands.name: Series guidance
content_islands.spec: Set a short heading and two columns of guidance above the examples. Explain why the small format rewards a simple cover.

content_islands.name: Mission series
content_islands.spec: Line up three tall covers at the same size. Vary the silhouette while keeping the title near the top and agency identification near the foot.

content_islands.name: Alternative small covers
content_islands.spec: Align a second row of three specimens. Retain each full cover boundary to show how its photograph, type or film strip fills the same narrow format.
